_comment: THE jobs order form. Keys starting with _ are comments. Every value here is a FACT or a one-word pick into an engine library; logic lives in the engine repo. Overlays (declared below) override per-key.

project.name: jobs
project.description: job-board scraping - 13 ATS platforms, ~5,671 boards, nightly

code._what: the jobs project's OWN repo (gate/sink/platforms/discovery) - not the engine, not this repo

temporal._address: which Temporal: production cluster Temporal, reached via port-forward today; the in-cluster DNS replaces this in a 'cluster' overlay when the gitops deploy lands

retry._why: FAIL LOUD doctrine: one attempt; the daily pass is the retry mechanism. Temporal's default is INFINITE - this must stay written down.

timeouts._why: no ceiling on a source: start_to_close absurdly high because the SDK requires one; no heartbeat - the daily presence gate is the dead-worker detector

temporal._payload: the 2MB law: raw bytes NEVER travel through Temporal - sinks write them, workflows carry counts

worker._slots: see calibration.worker_slots - the number lives THERE, once

trigger._what: one PlatformRun per enabled platform per night (python -m ingest.orchestration.trigger)
trigger._sources_limit: null = full fleet; an integer caps boards/platform for a bounded wave

database._which: which ClickHouse: production, database `ingest`, reached via port-forward today (in-cluster DNS via a 'cluster' overlay later)
database._creds: credentials ONLY as env-var NAMES here - secrets never in git; env values win over host/port/database above

source._what: the key resolver, ONE WORD from the engine's resolver library; for jobs a key IS a board slug, stated here (key_column) - the engine never knows the word

k8s._what: declared deploy facts consumed by the gitops manifests - never applied from here

overlays._what: per-instance overrides in overlays/<name>/jobs.json, selected with INGEST_OVERLAY=<name>; each restates ONLY what it changes
overlays.local: laptop via port-forwards (same as base today - exists so the mechanism is exercised)
overlays.cluster: in-cluster: Temporal and ClickHouse by service DNS in the data namespace, set by the worker Deployment

calibration._what: the sized numbers - LEARNED from the ledger, never invented; lo/hi bounds are physics and stay hard. A weekly recalibration writes value back here via MR.

detail_concurrency._why: concurrent detail fetches per source; AIMD down on 429s

refetch_days._why: full re-fetch interval - heals silently-edited details

observability._what: the dashboard is CODE (engine's observability library); views pick which tables it builds

scheduler._what: what fires the nightly run - the config repo's dags/ renders one Airflow DAG per spec from this
scheduler._cron: null = manual only; set a cron string and the generated DAG arms itself

test._what: THE TEST - escalation ladder: random fresh boards per rung, 4 -> 8 -> 16 -> PROVEN; a board is never tested twice; pass = evidence success AND the data validator
